title: Days of Interest on Reissued Income Annuities Installments
content:
For a reissued Ashgrove Income Annuities installment, the interest runs for these actual days:

- **Contract issued in Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey or New York** — from the installment's payment date to the reissue date.
- **Contract issued in any other state, confirmed payment instructions on file** — from the date the confirmed payment instructions were received to the reissue date. Confirmed instructions are the completed bank change request on the contract; where there are several, the latest received.
- In any other case neither of these periods applies.

| State of issue | Completed bank change request | Interest runs from | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| New Jersey | Any | The installment's payment date | The reissue date |
| Colorado | Received 10 June | 10 June | The reissue date |
| Colorado | None on file | Neither period applies | — |

**Count (hypothetical).** Payment date 1 May, instructions received 10 June, reissue on 30 June. A New York contract: 60 days. A Colorado contract: 20 days.
